interpretation.status: selected static resource literals and simple brush property records, not fully decoded XAML
interpretation.offsets: zero-based offsets relative to the XBF payload, not to the PRI container
interpretation.lengths: Windows logical/effective pixels where the named property is a length; thickness order left, top, right, bottom
interpretation.colors: AARRGGBB; values are input colors, not composited screen pixels
interpretation.times: Original float or duration string preserved; interpret according to property type and actual consumer
limitations: All 1481 non-placeholder XBF payloads were matched to the archived candidate hash and size; only selected named dictionaries were decoded.
Separate ControlCenter and ShellCommon implementations are retained; the resource values do not establish which branch is active at runtime.

Named brush tint and luminosity values are not the Windows compositor's final output. ThemeResource references, dynamic accent selection, Mica behavior, state selection and runtime positioning require further analysis.

The paginated view width and L2 frame minimum are directly referenced in the same ShellCommon template. KDE uses the inner 376px view width as its single card width, retains the existing home height when larger than the detail minimum, and clips to available work area. This is a documented host-layout adaptation, not proof of Windows outer window positioning.

The exact previous/next glyphs are declared in the media template; play/pause solid glyphs are reviewed original-font semantic candidates, not a decoded Windows runtime or AnimatedIcon state selection. Imported SVG geometry preserves the project's existing normalization rather than asserting exact font-em raster equivalence.

review_notes: The image template directly specifies 16x16. The battery templates have 16px and 12px font-size variants. Visible ink size and runtime small-mode selection still need verification.

The submit minimum dimensions do not establish the host credential field height. Both Qt hosts retain their previous button extents, subject to their existing constraints. The 12px font-size resource is used for the lock screen's text fallback. The actual FlowDirectionToForwardArrowConverter glyph remains unverified.

The separately installed system greeter currently installs its compatibility icon theme under /usr/share/icons; it does not deploy the private windows-modern/native-assets tree. Retain its existing icon loading path until a verified local asset deployment is designed. No new fallback path is introduced.

reviewed_usage.kde_adaptation: Use 296 logical pixels as the maximum width of the credential panel; allow the existing layout to shrink on smaller screens.

review_notes: These are minimum extents. KDE uses 220 as the full-search preferred baseline and grows the compact preferred size to fit translated text with the template's content padding. Existing constrained-height scaling is retained.
The exact runtime frame height, full-search icon extent and text style are not established.

Named literal resources are resolved through keyed dictionary references (root offsets 293331, 303185, 313041 and 322653 to node sections 1–4). They establish generic WinUI resource values, not the active runtime template for every shell surface. The current Quick Settings slider already uses an 18 logical-pixel thumb and a 4px track at its normal component scale; no duplicate implementation is needed.

This alternative dictionary from the same original PRI disagrees with the modern generic dictionary. Presence in the image does not establish active template selection; do not use these values interchangeably.

Keyed root dictionary reference at XBF offset 47483 points to node section 4. StartMenuExperienceHost AppxManifest activates StartDocked.dll native XAML classes (LauncherFrame, AllAppsPane, PowerOptionsView, UserTileView), while MicrosoftWindows.Client.Photon's Windows.Shell.StartMenu wsxpack (4.0.1419.0) supplies only the embedded React Native Recommended feed (Substrate/OneDrive/Edge/Teams/Promoted items). Small (642 = 33 + 6*96 + 33) and Large (834 = 33 + 8*96 + 33) XAML outer frame widths include outer padding/margins; KDE popupPosition.js retains inner content dimensions inside PlasmaCore.Dialog margins until full S01 layout reconciliation.

The native XAML frame explicitly references the StartResources geometry. The separate Photon bundle also exists in this build; active implementation and screen state selection are not established. Do not apply the XAML frame's dimensions to every Start configuration on this evidence alone.

Both slider orientations directly use the modern 18px thumb dimensions and 4px track. The existing KDE slider control paths remain responsible for keyboard, touch, wheel, tick marks, range and direction. WinUI progress bars separate a 1px track from the 3px minimum indicator; a single Qt style thickness cannot establish exact visual equivalence. Keep native Qt label layout and do not force this height onto capacity meters or unrelated app widgets.
StartDocked XAML host metrics confirm the 12px launcher frame margin, 642px minimum frame width, 48x48 navigation items and 32px user account avatar slot.

TaskbarSearchPageThemeResources establishes the 12px taskbar popup gap (TaskbarMargin) and the 33px horizontal Start search-box inset (FindInStartSearchBoxMargin / StartCP3SearchBoxMargin) vs 24px in standalone Search (SearchBoxMargin).
Styles.Win11 declares NotificationCenterFlyoutWidth=360, NotificationCenterFlyoutMargin=(12,8,12,0), GroupHeaderMinHeight=32 and 1px notification item plating border.
RefreshedStyles declares the 294px taskbar jump-list frame/control width, 14px item text and 12px category heading text.
LockApp StandardStyles defines 18px/14px large and small status glyph font sizes; DesktopMediaControlsOverlay uses LockFontFamily rather than a hardcoded font name.
